title: Draft: UFOs and the Intelligence Community Blind Spot to Surprise or Deceptive Data, January 1, 1968
doc_notes: This document is a draft NSA intelligence report discussing the psychological barriers within the intelligence community regarding the processing of unusual or deceptive data, including UFO sightings.

incidents.summary: An Air Force technician observed Soviet Bloc countries tracking a high-flying, fast-moving object with an erratic flight pattern that moved against the wind, which the Bloc nations officially designated as a balloon.
incidents.quote: A bloc country began to report a radar track of a high flying fast moving object with an erratic flight pattern.

incidents.summary: Historical reference to Americans being destroyed by fast, erratic-moving oval guided missiles from Russia, which were dismissed as mental illusions.
incidents.quote: Americans refused to believe that fast erratic moving oval objects were anything but mental illusions
